name: Bosnia and Herzegovina
dossier:
The Bosnia and Herzegovina national football team, affectionately known to their passionate supporters as the Zmajevi, enter the FIFA World Cup 2026 with high expectations. Currently ranked number 64 in the world, they bring a unique tactical identity and style from UEFA to this expanded 48-team tournament.

The dragons return to the world stage, armed with defensive grit and a legendary forward in Džeko.

With the tournament co-hosted across the United States, Mexico, and Canada, Bosnia and Herzegovina will count on their travelling support to create a vibrant atmosphere. Their primary objective will be to make a statement in Group B and navigate their way to the high-stakes knockout rounds.
whatToWatch: Keep a close eye on their transition play in Group B. The connection between Edin Džeko and Sead Kolašinac is crucial to their attacking spark.
xFactor: Edin Džeko - the clinical striker who holds the ability to turn a match on its head with a single moment of magic.
verdict: Bosnia and Herzegovina are poised to be one of the most intriguing stories of the group stage, bringing great energy to the tournament.
funFacts: Bosnia's golden generation in 2014 was led by Edin Džeko  -  their legend returned to guide their return.
Bosnia and Herzegovina boast 0 World Cup titles in their historical cabinet, with their best tournament finish being Group stage (2014).
